text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Yamanin Zephyr wasn't feeling well, 
I decided to have her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems a sudden chill has caught 
me... With a little rest, I'm sure the 
storm within me shall settle..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? This is... an unfamiliar forest, 
isn't it? And yet, it feels very sunny and 
warm...—
What's that!? Say that again!
Hmph, you can't even hold a candle to me!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...? I hear a voice from somewhere... It 
feels sharp and thorny... like a black 
wind...

Wah, look out?! Watch where you're 
stepping! You're gonna crush us!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy dandelion puffballs...! Could you 
be the ones who were speaking just now?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text:
That's right, of course it is. ...Ah! 
Maybe I should ask you to be the judge!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A judge...?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's great! Who do you think can 
blow their dandelion fluff further, me or 
this guy!?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The dandelion fluff... I'm sorry, I don't 
have a ruler on me...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, let's go ask Kuromame-san over there.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text:
...Come again? Black beans? —Ah, you mean 
ants!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Kuromame-san, I have a favor to ask. Could 
you gather your friends and help measure 
how far the dandelion fluff flew?

text_block_list.name: Passing Ant
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... I'm busy too, you know. That 
said, if you were to grace me with 
something sweet, I might consider it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Something sweet... nectar from a flower, 
perhaps? Um, excuse me, Mr. Dandelion... 
Would you mind sharing a little of your 
nectar?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text:
No, we're already cotton, so I don't think 
we have any nectar to share...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. Well then, I'll go look 
for some flowers that might share their 
nectar with me.

text_block_list.name: Passing Ant
text_block_list.text:
Um, we are busy as well, so if you cannot 
have it ready right away, I shall take my 
leave...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, please wait, Kuromame-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It fell into the gap between the 
rocks... What should we do? I can't fit in 
there...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, but if I try my best, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft—Ahaha! It's okay, don't force it! 
We're sorry, it was our fault for fighting 
like that!"

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text:
It's not much of an apology, but... do you 
want to hang out together?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You'll let me join? Little 
Dandelion's games... sound quite 
intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great, let's play, let's play! How 
about we search for funny clouds? Or we 
could look for ones shaped like animals!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Cloud watching... Hehe, sounds fun. —Oh, 
doesn't that cloud over there look a 
little like a turtle?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Ah... a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but still... it was such a 
delightful, yet spring-breeze-like 
dream...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she had a pleasant dream. Yamanin 
Zephyr's expression was bright, as if she 
had regained all her energy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then... I'll walk it and count 
how many steps it takes.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Alright, you're on! Let's have a showdown!

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Go for it! Fly high--!

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text:
—Wah-oof! Hey, you! Stop blowing dandelion 
fluff at me!! Well, two can play at that 
game!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... They ended up landing right next to 
each other. I wonder which dandelion fluff 
belonged to whom...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um, please wait a moment... This piece of 
fluff is two steps... and this one is 
three steps...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"So, regarding these two fluffballs... 
Uhm...? Which one belongs to who...?"

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text:
"...Even I don't know. He keeps blowing 
fluff at me, so... this will never settle 
things."

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Nothing beats a head-to-head 
showdown after all!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Both of them are at the mercy of 
the autumn wind... What should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I wasn't able to be of any help to 
Tanpopo-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I had been more like the gentle spring 
breeze, I wonder if we could have made 
up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to a bad dream, Yamanin Zephyr 
couldn't regain her top form.
